entities.name: Plargg
entities.description: Gruff blind orc shaman and Dean of the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios, specializing in military history.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven University where Plargg teaches.

entities.name: Augusta
entities.description: Dean at Strixhaven whose attempts to find order in chaos Plargg dismisses.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Plargg was among the surviving professors.

events.summary: Plargg invents heat lettering, magical parchment embossing for tactile reading.
Plargg survives the New Phyrexian Invasion and helps restore Strixhaven.
events.quote: Plargg was one of the surviving professors after the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: He is a teacher at Lorehold College.
relations.quote: is an orc shaman teacher at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University

relations.note: Plargg dismisses Dean Augusta's work as a foolhardy waste of time.
relations.quote: He pays little attention to Dean Augusta 's work
